techcrunch.title: As AI content floods the internet, Pangram raises $9M to detect it
techcrunch.summary: Pangram has raised $9 million to scale its AI detection software. The startup has also released a new AI text detection model, Pangram 4, and an AI image detection model in research preview.

techcrunch.title: Cyera agrees to acquire Oasis Security for $1B to safeguard proliferating AI agents
techcrunch.summary: The deal is Cyera's third acquisition this year.

techcrunch.title: Bot-detection startup Spur nabs $200M from Insight
techcrunch.summary: Spur Intelligence has raised a $200 million round from Insight Partners for its tech that can identify legit human traffic from bots.

techcrunch.title: MCP startup Runlayer accuses Rippling of stealing its product idea

techcrunch.title: Sam Altman is ready to decelerate
techcrunch.summary: His change of position comes after "the first security incident that I have felt very viscerally."

techcrunch.title: Data centers may face temporary power cuts to prevent blackouts on largest US grid
techcrunch.summary: The decision arrives as the breakneck pace of data center construction has grid operators scrambling to generate power.

techcrunch.title: Fish Audio raises $52M seed to build AI voice models for creators and enterprises
techcrunch.summary: Since launching last year, the startup today has more than 8 million people using the open source or hosted version of its models, and now generates annual recurring revenue of $21 million.

techcrunch.title: Recursive Superintelligence signs $410M compute deal with Amazon
techcrunch.summary: Recursive’s emphasis on self-improving AI systems means much of the budget that would traditionally go toward headcount and operations is put straight into compute, as the company seeks to automate its own product development process.

techcrunch.title: Cursor makes its biggest India push yet ahead of SpaceX acquisition with localized pricing
techcrunch.summary: Cursor says India is now its third-largest market globally and plans to expand local hiring and enterprise sales.

techcrunch.title: Anthropic’s Dario Amodei responds: doesn’t oppose open-weight models, but fears Chinese AI
techcrunch.summary: Anthropic founder and CEO Dario Amodei made his views clear about open-weight models and China's growing AI capabilities.
